en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a lively European city street lined with multi‑story buildings, storefronts with striped awnings, pedestrians, cyclists, and a few early 20th‑century vehicles. Shop signs are visible on both sides, including a prominent corner building with the word "BISCHOFF" and various hanging signs. In the background, several church spires or tall towers rise above the rooftops. At the bottom margin, printed caption text reads "Nijmegen, Molenstraat."
